name: Jalovec (Prievidza District, Slovakia)
description: Divided per saltire into white at the hoist and top and dark blue at the fly and bottom, with a yellow saltire, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature J-15/1995.
